title: Multiple Choice - Opposite in Meaning
description: Choose the word or phrase OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.text: Moving into a completely [unfamiliar] neighborhood can initially cause anxiety for young students living away from home.
The sudden [popularity] of folk music workshops attracted hundreds of high school students every Saturday.
Through community volunteer work, teenagers learn to [appreciate] the cultural contributions of elderly craftspeople.
Skilled culinary chefs know how to seamlessly [blend] contrasting spices without overwhelming the palate.
Citizens gathered in the central plaza to [celebrate] their national sporting triumph with songs and fireworks.
